item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows Ojas's plane-mirror set-up. An incident ray meets the mirror at point O. The dashed line at O is drawn at 90° to the mirror. The reflected ray leaves O. Ojas keeps a flat cardboard sheet under these rays so he can trace them.

Which claims are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.A: The incident ray, the dashed normal, and the reflected ray all lie in the same plane.
options.B: A flat sheet under the rays can hold all three lines because they share one plane.
options.C: The dashed line is only another name for the incident ray, so only two lines matter.
options.D: The same-plane rule applies only to curved mirrors, not to this plane mirror.
